name: Merchant
description: Traders, freighter crews, and brokers who make their living through interstellar commerce.

assignments.name: Merchant Marine
assignments.description: You work on one of the massive cargo haulers that ply the space lanes.

assignments.name: Free Trader
assignments.description: You are part of the crew of a tramp trader or a free merchant vessel.

assignments.name: Broker
assignments.description: You work in a planetside brokerage or commercial office.

events.description: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.effectDescription: Roll on the Mishap table but remain in career.

effects.detail: Roll on Mishap table, stay in career

events.description: You are offered the opportunity to smuggle illegal items onto a planet.
events.effectDescription: If you accept, roll Deception 8+ or Persuade 8+. Succeed: gain an extra Benefit roll. Fail: roll on the Mishap table and ejected. If you refuse, gain an Enemy.

effects.detail: Accept (Deception/Persuade 8+ for Benefit or Mishap) or refuse (Enemy)

events.description: You make a good deal on some cargo.
events.effectDescription: Gain DM+1 to any one Benefit roll and gain Broker 1.

events.description: You are approached by a shady character who offers you money to smuggle contraband.
events.effectDescription: If you accept, gain Streetwise 1 and an extra Benefit roll. If you refuse, nothing happens.

events.description: You are given advanced training in a specialist field.
events.effectDescription: Roll EDU 8+ to gain any skill.

events.description: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.effectDescription: Roll on the Life Events table.

events.description: You have a chance to risk your cargo for a bigger payoff.
events.effectDescription: Roll Gambler 8+ or Broker 8+. Succeed: gain an extra Benefit roll. Fail: lose a Benefit roll.

effects.detail: Gambler/Broker 8+ for Benefit or lose Benefit

events.description: You are embroiled in legal trouble.
events.effectDescription: Gain one of Advocate 1, Admin 1, Diplomat 1 or Investigate 1.

effects.detail: Gain Advocate 1, Admin 1, Diplomat 1 or Investigate 1

events.description: You make an unexpected connection outside your normal circles.
events.effectDescription: Gain a Contact and DM+1 to any one Benefit roll.

events.description: A good deal ensures you are living the high life for a few years.
events.effectDescription: Gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll and gain an Ally.

events.description: Your business venture succeeds beyond your expectations.

mishaps.effectDescription: Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.

effects.detail: Roll twice on Injury table, take lower result

mishaps.description: You are bankrupted by a failed deal. You salvage what you can. Gain nothing from this career.
mishaps.effectDescription: Lose all Benefit rolls from this career.

mishaps.description: A sudden war destroys your trade routes and holdings, forcing you to flee.
Your ship or business is captured by someone hostile. Gain an Enemy.
A partner betrays you. Gain a Rival. Gain Broker 1 or Streetwise 1.
mishaps.effectDescription: Gain a Rival. Gain Broker 1 or Streetwise 1.

mishaps.description: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.
